name: 60304 · Oak Park, IL
findings: ZIP 60304 (Oak Park) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60304 (Oak Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
